correctness.rationale: From the classical Picard blow-up model, 27 explicit (-1)-classes and 45 anticanonical triples give the two Galois sets. The packaged verifier independently identifies all 45 triples from the intersection graph; generates 51,840 Weyl elements, 25 exact conjugacy classes, and computes every induced cycle structure and fixed-point count without approximation. It establishes 19/23/25 distinct profiles and the two exact sharpness collisions. Published large-field equidistribution ensures actual realization of the collisions for all sufficiently large q; no claim about every small q.

value.rationale: This solves the natural problem of recovering a cubic surface’s arithmetic Picard Weyl type from small extension-field counts of two canonical finite etale configuration schemes. Each scheme separately loses Weyl types, but their joint first-three-degree data are complete. The sharp two-degree counterexamples establish a genuine arithmetic boundary, with practical finite-field type-detection value.
